result:
The quietest sound in the world is not silence.

It is the moment after a storm when the rain has stopped, and the leaves are still dripping, and somewhere far away a bird clears its throat and begins again.

It is the second a person forgives without saying so.

It is the pause before you realize you’ve been holding your breath.

Even the air seems to lean in, listening for what comes next.
